title: Who Left the Heater On?

pre.en: What was using so much electricity?

intro: 这是公寓的群聊：小陈、Tom 和常来吃饭的 Priya 为了一张翻了倍的电费单，查起了「谁没关电器」。读的时候留意 too 和 enough：too cold to …（太冷，没法…）、not warm enough to …（不够暖和，没法…）、enough money to …——说「太」和「够不够」。

sentences.en: The electricity bill for February has just arrived, and I've paid it.
sentences.zh: 二月的电费单刚到，我已经交了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: That's twice as much as January.
sentences.zh: 是一月的两倍。

sentences.en: Seriously?
sentences.zh: 不是吧？
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: Well, it's been too cold to turn anything off.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这阵子太冷了，什么都不敢关。

sentences.en: My room's like a fridge until the heating kicks in at six.
sentences.zh: 暖气六点才热起来，在那之前我房间跟冰箱似的。

sentences.en: Your room?
sentences.zh: 你的房间？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Mine isn't warm enough to work in, so I've been going to the library.
sentences.zh: 我那间冷得根本没法干活，我这阵子一直跑去图书馆。

sentences.en: Before you two start making excuses, let me look into the meter readings.
sentences.zh: 你俩先别急着找借口，我来查查电表读数。
sentences.speaker: Priya

sentences.en: I'm an accountant — I love this stuff.
sentences.zh: 我是会计，就爱干这个。

sentences.en: OK, the numbers don't add up.
sentences.zh: 好了，这些数字对不上。
sentences.speaker: Priya

sentences.en: Even on days when you were both at work, the flat used more electricity than a small café.
sentences.zh: 就连你俩都去上班的日子，家里用的电都比一家小咖啡馆还多。

sentences.en: Someone's been leaving something on all day.
sentences.zh: 有人一直把什么东西整天开着。

sentences.en: Not me.
sentences.zh: 不是我。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I don't earn enough money to heat an empty flat.
sentences.zh: 我挣的钱可不够给空房子供暖。

sentences.en: And I can't afford bills like this.
sentences.zh: 这样的账单我也付不起。

sentences.en: We need to make changes to how we use energy, then.
sentences.zh: 那咱们用电的习惯得改改了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: For a start, I'm in favour of shorter showers.
sentences.zh: 首先，我赞成洗澡时间短一点。

sentences.en: Shorter showers?
sentences.zh: 洗短点？
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: I'm a chef.
sentences.zh: 我可是厨师。

sentences.en: After a twelve-hour shift, a hot shower is part of a balanced diet.
sentences.zh: 干完十二个小时的班，洗个热水澡就是均衡饮食的一部分。

sentences.en: Cold ones aren't on the menu.
sentences.zh: 冷水澡？我这儿可没这道菜。

sentences.en: Fair enough.
sentences.zh: 行吧，有道理。
sentences.speaker: Priya

sentences.en: But let's keep a record of the smart meter readings for a week, three times a day.
sentences.zh: 不过咱们把智能电表的读数记一个星期，每天记三次。

sentences.en: Deal.
sentences.zh: 成交。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: And Chen, I'll pay you back £30 for my extra hot showers.
sentences.zh: 还有小陈，我多洗的那些热水澡，补给你 30 英镑。

sentences.en: Thanks — that's more than enough.
sentences.zh: 谢啦，这就绰绰有余了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Day three, and I've found it.
sentences.zh: 第三天，找到了。
sentences.speaker: Priya

sentences.en: Even at 3 am, when you're both asleep, the meter's still going up fast.
sentences.zh: 就连夜里三点，你俩都睡着了，电表还在蹭蹭往上走。

sentences.en: It's the dehumidifier in the hall cupboard.
sentences.zh: 是门厅柜子里那台除湿机。

sentences.en: It's been running non-stop since January.
sentences.zh: 从一月起就没停过。

sentences.en: We've got a dehumidifier?
sentences.zh: 咱们家还有除湿机？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: My mum gave it to us for Christmas.
sentences.zh: 我妈圣诞节送的。
sentences.speaker: Tom

sentences.en: She said it would save us money.
sentences.zh: 她说能帮咱们省钱。

cards.note: to start to have an effect
cards.tip: 主语是药、暖气、规定之类：The new rules kick in next month.
cards.example: The painkillers kicked in after twenty minutes.

cards.note: to give a reason for something you did or did not do, which is often not the true reason
cards.tip: 动词用 make，不用 find 或 say；为某事找借口用 for。
cards.example: Stop making excuses and finish the report.

cards.note: to try to find out the facts about a problem
智能电表是 smart meter，英国家庭很常见。
accounts 是「账目」，accountant 是管账的人。
if numbers or facts do not add up, they do not make sense or seem wrong
cards.tip: 多用否定：It doesn't add up.；本义是「加起来」：add up the numbers。
cards.example: His story doesn't add up — he said he was at home, but his car was gone.

cards.note: to not switch off a light or machine
cards.tip: 反义是 switch / turn sth off；代词放中间：leave it on。
cards.example: Did you leave the oven on again?

cards.note: earn a living 是「谋生」。
to not have enough money to pay for something
cards.tip: 后面接名词或 to do：can't afford to buy a car；不说 can't afford buying。
cards.example: We can't afford a holiday this year.

cards.note: to change parts of something
to support an idea or a plan
上夜班是 work the night shift。
a way of eating that includes the right amounts of different kinds of food
cards.tip: 常说 eat / have a balanced diet；diet 在这里是「日常饮食」，不是「节食」。
cards.example: Children need a balanced diet with plenty of vegetables.

cards.note: available to eat at a meal or in a restaurant
used to say that you accept what someone has said, even if you do not fully agree
cards.tip: 英国口语里很常用，带一点「勉强同意」的意思；单独成句。
cards.example: "I can't come — I'm working late." "Fair enough."

cards.note: to write down information regularly so that you can look at it later
cards.tip: record 作名词重音在前 /ˈrekɔːd/，作动词重音在后。
cards.example: Keep a record of everything you spend this month.

cards.note: 这里不是「阅读」，是表上显示的数。
to give someone back the money that you owe them
cards.tip: 钱数可以放在后面：pay you back £30；也有「报复」的意思，看上下文。
cards.example: Can I borrow a tenner? I'll pay you back tomorrow.

cards.note: humid 是「潮湿的」，de- 表示「去掉」。
也可以作形容词：a non-stop flight（直飞航班）。
